notes:
What’s new in 0.1.37:
• The converter now looks inside each video instead of judging by the file name, so .mkv and .avi files that already play fine are no longer queued.
• Anything you’ve already watched properly is left alone.
• When a file does need work, Beebo uses the quickest fix: repackage in seconds, convert just the audio, or a full re-encode only for truly old formats.
• Your conversion queue is cleaned up once after updating, and each file now says why it needs converting, with “Don’t convert” and “Convert anyway” buttons.
